changelog.change: Reconciled the handoff with recreated prototypes, verified flows, responsive behavior, and browser test results

overview: Northstar Pricing is a browser-based prototype for managing a service company's four-level price configuration: Price Books contain Price Categories, which contain hierarchical Price Headers, which contain Price Items. Users can review and maintain sample records through a consistent list-and-detail interface, use cascading filters to narrow child records, and move between levels with the progression links. The prototype is a local interaction model, not a connected pricing system.

flows_summary.description: Price Book to Price Category to Price Header to Price Item navigation
Shared record create, copy, edit, validation, discard, and remove states

component_notes: All screens share the Northstar shell, progression navigation, record-action toolbar, scroll-contained data table, tabbed detail card, status messaging, and accessible remove-confirmation dialog. SCR-102 through SCR-104 add progressively deeper cascading selectors. Wide tables and tab strips scroll within their own containers on narrow screens.
design_rationale_highlights: A shared list-and-detail pattern across the four entities reflects the repeated structure in the source requirements and keeps the journey consistent
Cascading filters expose parent-child dependencies directly, and SCR-103 computes nested header levels from the selected parent
The two unresolved Price Item flag names remain marked [REVIEW NEEDED] and disabled rather than guessed

prototype_guide.journey_summary: Open SCR-101 and follow progression links through Price Category, Price Header, and Price Item. Back links and browser history were exercised. Browser checks verified CRUD, validation, filters, dialog dismissal, responsive layouts, and nested-header level calculation.
limitations: Records are in-memory sample data and reset on reload
No backend, persistence, or external resources are connected
The two unresolved Price Item flag fields remain disabled until their names are confirmed
open_issues: Confirm the two Price Item flag names with the business stakeholder before treating SCR-104 as implementation-ready
